column1: # /Range Format Other Color Negative <color> — tint negative values
# in a per-format color. Reset clears the override.
# /Range Format Other Color Negative Red applied to A1..A2.
# A1 is positive — no fg override applied.
# A2 is negative — rendered with the red override.
# (Pointer must NOT be on A2, since the highlight style on the pointer
# cell suppresses any per-cell color override — that's how 1-2-3 keeps
# /Range Format Other Color Reset on A2 — drops the override. Move
# pointer to A2 in POINT mode so the range is A2..A2 (single cell).
